name: SpaceNet 7: Multi-Temporal Urban Development Satellite Benchmark
description: SpaceNet 7 (The Multi-Temporal Urban Development Challenge) tracks building construction and urban change over monthly time series of satellite imagery. It comprises deep multi-temporal imagery stacks collected monthly over 24 months (2018–2020) across 101 distinct geographic areas of interest (AOIs) covering 41,000 km² worldwide. Each AOI includes monthly PlanetScope 3.0m optical imagery and detailed polygon annotations for over 10 million building footprints tracked individually with unique persistence IDs across time to evaluate spatio-temporal object tracking and footprint extraction.
